title: H3 AI Influencer v2
description: Animates your image as the first frame, after SeedVR2 restores it to the video size: sharper faces from small or soft pictures.

labels.1:image: First frame: your image (<Picture 1> in the prompt)
labels.100:value: Describe the motion, the speech and the sound. Refer to your image as <Picture 1>.

hints: Good for small or soft source images: SeedVR2 restores the first frame before it is animated.
Write the timeline of the shot in the prompt: who speaks when, and what they say in quotes.
5-6 s clips give the steadiest faces. For longer videos use Long video, which chains clips.
